scenarios.requirement: A command the assistant starts gets an environment built from a list: no provider key, key-file pointer, agent socket, desktop or bus variable, preload or shell-startup variable, and no git command variable; the base, the toolchain names and git's author and committer stay

The claude engines keep their own login and route variables and a hosted command of the user's keeps OPENAI_*; no engine keeps another provider's key, the agent socket, the desktop or a key-file pointer

AIContainEnv adds names to every profile and AIHostEnv to the user's hosted command only; a key, the agent socket or a preload named there is still dropped, and LD_LIBRARY_PATH is the one dropped name a list may keep
Only the commit of a repository that signs with ssh keeps the agent socket
The test seam keeps a named prefix and is reported, and refuses every prefix that would pass a key, an agent, the desktop, the bus, the loader or git's command variables
The PATH a profile gives drops empty, '.' and relative entries; an engine's PATH also drops the workspace's own folders unless the seam names one
A program is found in the parent along the safe PATH; a relative entry is never searched, so a program in the working folder is not found
The file-size limit and the containment mode read their text, with the documented default
The report names what is held (fs=none net=uncontrolled), the header word is UNCONTAINED, and the notice names what is not held and is said once per session
An assistant start that names no containment profile is refused before the fork with EPERM, traced and said, and nothing runs; the same start with a profile runs
Strict refuses every profile's start while the files and the network are not held, from the environment and from the config file, and the environment's word wins
A contained child sees the built environment, the 8 GiB file-size limit, no core limit and the no-new-privileges flag, and a user's limit replaces the default
Off keeps the environment list and sets no limit and no no-new-privileges flag
An engine never runs a program the workspace planted, whether named by a relative or an absolute entry of its PATH
An engine whose program sits in a workspace folder its PATH drops is refused with a sentence naming the folder and the reason; a folder the user allowed is kept and the engine starts
When the editor inherits a hard file-size limit below the default, assistant commands still start and get the inherited limit
A run_command never sees the editor's provider keys, agent socket, loader or git command variables, or key-file pointer
A run_command still has HOME, a PATH with the system folders and TERM=dumb
A run_command has the documented 8 GiB file-size limit, no core file and no_new_privs set
XWPE_AI_CONTAIN_FSIZE sets the file-size limit for a session
Strict from the environment stops the assistant's command before the fork and traces why
Strict in the user's own config holds against a start folder's xwperc that says off
AIContainEnv in the user's config keeps the names it lists for every command and no other
The claude backend keeps its login variables and gets no other provider's key, agent socket or loader variable
A claude that sits in the workspace's own folder on PATH is never the engine that runs
A hosted command of the user's keeps its OPENAI_* variables and the names AIHostEnv lists, and no other
The pane header ends with UNCONTAINED, and the first run says in the error colour what is not held, once, after the task line
The header word and the containment line are said once under the X11 editor
The header word and the containment line are said once under the Wayland editor
Strict stops the assistant's command before the fork under the X11 editor
Strict stops the assistant's command before the fork under the Wayland editor
A start folder's xwperc cannot add names to the environment a command gets or set the hosted names
Every assistant command still starts when the editor runs under a hard file-size limit below the default (run under prlimit)
An engine in a dropped workspace folder is named in the pane with the folder and the remedy
AIContainPathAllow in the user's own config keeps the folder an engine sits in
Only the commit of a repository that git says signs with ssh (true, yes, 1, on, a bare key) keeps the agent socket
A folder of AIContainPathAllow of 300 or 3000 bytes is kept whole on an engine's PATH, and an engine in it starts
An allowed word longer than 255 bytes never allows the shorter folder it begins with
A PATH entry too long for the system to open is dropped for an engine and kept for a command, and the entries around it keep their order
A folder with a space in AIContainPathAllow is one folder: the list is split at the colons only
A name of AIContainEnv longer than 255 bytes never keeps the variable named by its first 255 bytes
A workspace too long for the system to open refuses the assistant's start with the path-length sentence
